data: Run the console on a server

pgha is a Go command-line tool. It creates and manages a highly available PostgreSQL cluster on Hetzner Cloud.

This document is the full reference. For a short start, read README.md.
Release builds are on the public repository mantissatech/pgha-cli. The install page has the commands for the shell script, Homebrew, apt, yum, Scoop, and Win…
Each release also ships a free, public container image with the CLI and the web console. No login is needed to pull it.
Run the console on a server
This guide puts the web console on a small server that is always on. The team uses it from a browser. Nobody needs pgha.db or the SSH key on a laptop.
